claim: With IP-based routing you upload your data to Route 53 as user-IP-to-endpoint mappings, which gives you fine-grained control to boost performance or cut network costs; one common use case is routing end users from certain ISPs to specific endpoints.

evidence.quote: IP-based routing gives you fine-grained control to boost performance or cut network costs by uploading your data to Route 53 as user-IP-to-endpoint mappings.
You want to route end users from certain ISPs to specific endpoints so you can optimize network transit costs or performance.
